title: Relational Parenting Group for Opioid-addicted Mothers
brief_summary: This study is a randomized trial of interventions to improve parent-child relationships of drug-dependent mothers.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion criteria:

* female adult humans
* enrollment in methadone treatment for opioid addiction
* caring for a child between the ages of 7 and 14 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* suicidality/homicidality requiring more intensive level of care
* serious cognitive impairment (AIDS-related dementia or schizophrenia)
